body: A Vueling Airbus A320-200, registration EC-LVV, operating flight VY-3030 from Barcelona to Tenerife Norte, was on approach to Tenerife when the crew climbed back to a hold at FL070 to work the checklists after a problem with the nose gear steering developed. The aircraft then positioned for a landing on runway 30 about 30 minutes after entering the hold.

The aircraft was towed off the runway about 10 minutes after landing. The Aviation Herald report, created on October 27, 2026, records no further details about injuries or damage, and the incident is listed as a nose gear steering problem encountered during the approach to Tenerife.
en.summary: A Vueling A320 operating flight VY-3030 held at FL070 over Tenerife to work nose gear steering checklists, then landed on runway 30 and was towed off the runway.
en.title: Vueling A320 holds over Tenerife with nose gear steering problem, then lands and is towed off runway

facts.claim: A Vueling Airbus A320-200, registration EC-LVV, was operating flight VY-3030 from Barcelona to Tenerife Norte.
On approach to Tenerife, the crew climbed back to a hold at FL070 to work the checklists due to a problem with the nose gear steering.
The aircraft subsequently positioned for a landing on runway 30 about 30 minutes after entering the hold.
The aircraft was towed off the runway about 10 minutes after landing.

body: 伏林航空一架空中巴士A320-200客機、註冊編號EC-LVV，執行VY-3030航班由巴塞隆納飛往特內里費北部機場（TFN），在進場特內里費時因前起落架轉向出現問題，機組員爬升回到FL070高度等待，依檢查表處置。約30分鐘後，飛機重新定位，降落在30跑道。
飛機落地約10分鐘後被拖離跑道。航空先驅報於2026年10月27日的紀錄將此事件列為進場時遭遇的前起落架轉向問題，未進一步說明人員傷亡或飛機損傷情形。
zh.summary: 伏林航空A320執行VY-3030航班時因前起落架轉向問題在特內里費上空FL070等待處置，隨後降落30跑道並被拖離跑道。
zh.title: 伏林航空A320特內里費前起落架轉向異常，盤旋處置後落地並拖離跑道
